request: 继续主目标：当前实例复核推理强度写回隔离，验收Markdown历史存储管理和备份界面；Windows由用户验收，真实向量暂缓
acceptance: 当前9999两个专用空会话推理强度通过UI写入，API与磁盘一致，切换与刷新不串值
核对历史备份/管理既有直接证据，避免把已验证项目继续列为未验
实际工作台验证专用Markdown混合PNG/JPEG资源版本恢复，并逐项核对完整字节
保全原会话、配置与来源，记录原目标仍缺项；沿用当前精确指纹full105门禁并推送文档
scope: 仅专用空会话和自有临时文件/历史

requirements.summary: 继续原12项，不因局部验收重定义整体完成。发现历史管理已有实际Safari证据，主账本旧待办需纠正。

design.summary: Reproduced disk-restored V1 with Safari still displaying V2 PNG/JPEG. Bind resource URL revision to restore journal before preview input; ordinary renders stay stable. Also retain draw.io mutation revision across re-renders and export.

implementation.summary: Both editor history callbacks invalidate resource URLs before preview events; shared raw URL preserves source/workspace/auth identity and adds only resource revision. Draw.io uses same persistent revision. Failure-before/pass-after focused regression.

verification.summary: Actual Safari9999 saved owned A high/B medium; API and canonical disk match, both runs empty. Continue reload and mixed resource history.

release_authorization: 原目标授权连续开发、测试、文档与增量main推送；不创建版本/tag/正式Release；Windows用户验收、真实向量暂缓。
rollback: 只清理经身份/空任务校验的自有验收会话及专用文件，保留原会话、认证、设置、来源和历史；不执行保留策略或GC。
